title: Large-Area SEM Image Analysis of Semiconductors Using Deep Learning and Statistical Analysis
content: The continuous advancement of FLASH NAND semiconductor technology has increased the demand for precise, automated inspection methods to ensure quality control and manufacturing consistency. Traditional image processing techniques, which rely on thresholding or edge detection, often fall short in accurately identifying defects and variations due to the complexity of semiconductor structures and the variability in scanning electron microscope (SEM) images. To address these limitations, this study leverages deep learning-based segmentation techniques combined with Python-based image processing and statistical analysis to analyze structures over different areas in NAND effectively. This methodology allows for enhanced defect detection, quantitative trend analysis across different positions, and improved insights into manufacturing stability.
